items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Was here in TAM? Yeah, Arthur P. Williams School.

ctx.x: Well, I had to eat, I had to sleep, I had to pay rent, my children had to continually go to school.

Yeah. I was doing the suffering, you know, because I had to see that they make it, you know. How far did you get in school? Really, I didn't go to school. I went to school in third grade. Up to third grade? Yeah. I went in in third grade and I got out in third grade. I really didn't get no place. Was here in TAM? Yeah, Arthur P. Williams School. Arthur P. Williams, where was that?
That was on? That was on, Perdita and. Yeah, it was a downtown school.
